set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- Default UCOOT and across-spaces calls succeed on documented minimal examples.
- Unsupported l2/mm/lbfgsb choices are implemented or removed from accepted choices.
- Errors occur before computation and name the supported alternatives.
- Rd/vignette/pkgdown signatures agree.
- Regression tests cover defaults and every advertised choice.
set.title: Repair UCOOT defaults and make advertised choices truthful
